description.tr: Kâtib, müverrih, edîb, Şîî, Kûfe ehli. Kendisine el-ʿAzîz (tasgîr) veya Hammâr el-ʿAzîz lakabı veril
description.en: A scribe, historian, man of letters, Shīʿī from the people of Kufa. He was given the epithet al-ʿAzī
